scope: Research-only Biscayne Bay GIS evidence. Not production model input.

policy.immutable_inputs: Persisted source extracts are reused as versioned snapshots. Do not redownload unless the source version changes, a source is missing, or a documented QA issue requires replacement.
policy.derived_outputs: Regenerate only the outputs affected by a changed input or analysis script.
policy.geometry: Preserve source geometry and attributes. Do not snap, dissolve, bridge, or infer connectivity without an explicit evidence-backed operation.
policy.promotion: No feature becomes a legal boundary, ecological boundary, navigation boundary, current habitat condition, or species suitability score solely because it intersects another layer.

datasets.snapshot_summary: 46 curated original polygons from 189 extracted source features; source polygons remain individually preserved.
limitations: Chart context, not a complete ecological or statutory boundary.
Source chart dates vary; not a current habitat or navigation survey.

datasets.role: Project-specific Mean High Water shoreline candidates
datasets.snapshot_summary: FL1808A: 58 natural MHW features, 39.440 km. FL1808C: 70 features, 18.029 km. FL2317: no natural MHW features.
limitations: Survey/project extents are not ecological bay boundaries.
MHW is not bathymetry, a channel centerline, or a fish-passage layer.

datasets.snapshot_summary: Two separate preserve features: Biscayne Bay OBJECTID 43 and Biscayne Bay-Cape Florida to Monroe County Line OBJECTID 25.
limitations: Approximate management GIS geometry, not legal survey or enforcement geometry.
Do not merge the two preserve records or use them as ecological subregion boundaries.

datasets.snapshot_summary: 219 individually preserved source patches within the source-map footprints; source polygons are not dissolved.
limitations: Historical mapping, not current substrate or exposure.
Patch polygons are not named flat complexes or species-suitability evidence.

datasets.source: NOAA composite shoreline and MHHW screening services; source metadata persisted alongside outputs.
limitations: Composite line classes are not interchangeable.
Predicted MHHW screening geometry is not surveyed MHW.
Cross-source matches remain unresolved unless exact source identifiers and geometry support them.
Unnamed NOAA bridge features must not be assigned names by proximity.

refresh_triggers: An upstream source publishes a newer version or corrected geometry.
A persisted source file is missing or fails integrity/geometry validation.
A documented source-specific QA issue requires re-extraction.
The analysis requires a field not present in the frozen snapshot.

next_research_task.objective: Resolve published North/Central/South Biscayne Bay landmark locations and assess candidate cross-bay separators and feature memberships without fabricating boundary lines.
